messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up 2 Lodestar wants a last-mile perf check tomorrow 07:00 PT. Ask: mixed workload 700 sustained qps, 25m soak. Mix: 60% embeddings (batched), 40% chat (avg ctx 600 tokens). Target: chat p95 < 170ms, p99 < 420ms. They need customer CMK envelope encryption and audit logs. Need a short run plan, ops flags, and a ballpark cost delta. Can @Owen own infra and @Priya the harness?

Owen: Recommend Dedicated pool in us-west-2. For 700 qps with that ctx, plan for 3-4 GPU-equivalents (depends on quant). Enable embed batching at gateway and prefix+KV cache for chat. I'll provision KMS-proxy in the POC network to stabilize unwrap latency.

Priya: I'll run harness. Phases: smoke 5m @50 qps, ramp 10m to 700, soak 25m, cooldown 5m. Capture p50/p95/p99, embed tps, kv hit rate, and span traces. Load config I'll use:
```json
{"target_qps":700,"ramp_mins":10,"soak_mins":25,"mix":[{"type":"embed","pct":60,"batch_max":32},{"type":"chat","pct":40,"ctx":600}],"metrics":["p50","p95","p99","embed_tps","kv_hit"]}
```

Devon: Ops flags: model_batch_size=12, token_budget_ms=160, kv_cache_ttl=8h, embed_batching_enabled=true, embed_max_batch=32, trace_sample=0.05. Fallback: if p95 > 220ms route embeds to quant-embed-v2 and spin up an extra node. Set request_timeout=30s and retry=1.

Maya: Good. @Priya schedule 07:00 PT and tag run "lodestar-poc-6149991234". @Owen drop KMS checklist (short) and @Devon post ops JSON by EOD. I'll ask Finance for a rough cost delta after config is posted.

bench-bot: Run queued by Priya  id: br-6149991234, start_time: 2026-05-22T14:00:00Z, phases: smoke/ramp/soak/cooldown.

Priya: Harness queued and smoke script passed. Will post p50/p95/p99 + 2-line ops actions after soak.

Owen: KMS checklist (short): 1) CMK ARN & ownership confirm, 2) signed KMS addendum, 3) allowlist KMS endpoint, 4) KMS-proxy creds, 5) test unwrap report.

Devon: Ops JSON will be in the POC folder by EOD. Will include fallback routing rules and autoscale min nodes.

Maya: Thanks team ":thumbsup:""
